title: SIDESTORY: HERE A PEOPLE SOWS OPEN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: HERE A PEOPLE SOWS OPEN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Here A People Sows event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 3 phases:
- Phase 1 Agricultural Plate
- Phase 2 City Core
DURATION: August 7, 2024, 16:00 - August 21, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Phase 3 Far Side of the Great River
DURATION: August 14, 2024, 16:00 - August 21, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Commissions from the Tianshi Bureau]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Commissions from the Tianshi Bureau] by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Wanqing], Dahuang Tianshi Institute Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Sky Pole, etc.
[Shennong Market]
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Sky Pole by clearing event stages and completing [Commissions from the Tianshi Bureau]. Sky Pole can be used to redeem items from [Shennong Market].

REWARDS: Wanqing's token, Dahuang Tianshi Institute Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, [★★★★★: Bibeak], Bibeak's Token, 0011 Collection Outfit - Night Watcher for Hibiscus, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
- During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in [Public Affairs].
LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – REAP OF MILLE N IA

DETAILS: During the Limited-time Headhunting, [Reap of Millenia], the following Operators will appear at a higher rate: ★★★★★★: Shu [Limited] / Zuo Le ★★★★★★: Dusk [Limited] / Ling [Limited] / Chongyue [Limited]
★★★★★: Grain Buds
NOTE:
- [Reap of Millenia] is part of the [Limited Headhunting - Festival] headhunting series.
- [Limited Headhunting - Festival] is Limited Headhunting.
- Zuo Le and Grain Buds will become available in [Standard Headhunting] after August 14, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Shu is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Festival], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.
- Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 SEASONS FOURFOLD, REAP OF MILLENIA LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: Players can log in during the event to claim reward on event page: Bountiful Harmony Headhunting Permit * 1

NOTE: - Bountiful Harmony Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [Reap of Millenia] Limited Headhunting. - Bountiful Harmony Headhunting Permit expires at: August 14, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Each account can only claim this reward once during the event.
04 SEASONS FOURFOLD, DAILY FREE ROLL IN [REAP OF MILLENIA ] LIMITED HEADHUNTING

DETAILS: A free roll can be performed every day during the event in [Reap of Millenia] Limited Headhunting. NOTE: - Daily Free Roll will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) every day. - Daily Free Roll can only be used once a day and will not accumulate.
05 SEASONS FOURFOLD, NEW OPERATOR S NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game.
★★★★★★: Shu [Limited]
★★★★★★: Zuo Le
★★★★★: Grain Buds
★★★★★: Wanqing
DETAILS:
- Shu is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Festival], and is NOT available in any [Standard Headhunting].
- Operator Wanqing is currently ONLY available from Here A People Sows event, and is NOT available in [Reap of Millenia] Limited Headhunting, [Standard Headhuntings] or [Kernel Headhuntings].
- After the [Reap of Millenia] banner ends, Operators Zuo Le and Grain Buds will become available in [Standard Headhuntings] after August 14, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Operators Shu, Zuo Le, Grain Buds, and Wanqing will gain more trust in the event stages during July 31, 2024, 10:00 - August 21, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
06 SEASONS FOURFOLD, LUNGMEN LUCKY STRIPS OPEN

DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Lucky Strips each day upon login. Consume trials to select Lucky Strips as permitted in [Lungmen Lucky Strips]. The Lucky Strip with the most Orundum will be awarded. Both trials for the day must be used before claiming the reward.
NOTE:
- There are 14 days at most for players to pick Lucky Strips.
- Players will randomly obtain following amount of Orundum from Lucky Strips:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800

- If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated, players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
- All the daily trials will be refreshed at 4:00 am (UTC-7) on the next day and cannot be accumulated.
07 SEASONS FOURFOLD, 0011 COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfits from 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
0011 Collection - Alighting for Chongyue
0011 Collection - Heavenly Mirage for Lin
0011 Collection - The Land With Me for Highmore
0011 Collection - Saturated Within Rain for Honeyberry
08 SEASONS FOURFOLD, RE-EDITION OUTFITS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
0011 Collection - Unfettered Freedom for Nian
0011 Tempest - Unfettered for Ceobe
0011 Tempest - Wild Flower of Street for Waai Fu
Vitafield [Camper] Series Classics - Snowy Plains in Words for Pozëmka
Vitafield [Camper] Series Classics - High Autumn for Proviso
Vitafield [Camper] Series Classics - Campfire Cooking Smoke for Mousse
EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects - Under A Veil for Manticore
09 SEASONS FOURFOLD, RHODES FASHION REVIEW OPEN
DETAILS: 104 Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Witch Feast Series - Moon Catastrborn for Blemishine
EPOQUE Collection - Heritage for Pallas
EPOQUE Collection - Masterpiece for Rosa
10 SEASONS FOURFOLD, RHODES ISLAND SPECIAL PACK AVAILABLE
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
Rhodes Island Special Pack

CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 90, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1, LMD * 260000, Strategic Battle Record * 30, Chip Catalyst * 4, Module Data Block * 4, Data Supplement Instrument * 20, Data Supplement Stick * 60
Rhodes Island Upgrade Pack
CONTENTS: Orundum * 5000, LMD * 100000, Chip Catalyst * 2, Tactical Battle Record * 30
City Tower Construction Pack
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 13, Nucleic Crystal Sinter * 2, Crystalline Electronic Unit * 2, Transmuted Salt Agglomerate * 2, Transmuted Salt * 2
Dahuang Sightseeing Pack

CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 24, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 2, LMD * 200000, Strategic Battle Record * 20, Tactical Battle Record * 30, Chip Catalyst * 2, Refined Solvent * 4, Cutting Fluid Solution * 4
Advanced Special Training Pack
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 19, Top Operator Training Apparatus * 1
Top Operator Training Apparatus: Use to level up a 6-star Operator who has been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 90. Resources already invested will not be returned after usage.
Shu's Spare Change Pack
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 16, LMD * 700000
Special Training Pack
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 11, Senior Operator Training Apparatus * 1
Senior Operator Training Apparatus: Use to level up a 5-star operator who has been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 80. Resources already invested will not be returned after usage.
Defender Chip Pack
CONTENTS: Defender Dualchip * 4, Defender Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
Guard Chip Pack
CONTENTS: Guard Dualchip * 4, Guard Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
11 RHODES ISLAND GIFT PACK AVAILABLE
Rhodes Island Gift Pack
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 51, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1, Orundum * 2100, Module Data Block * 4
Rhodes Island Headhunting Pack
Players need to choose one option from the following when purchasing this Headhunting pack:
Type-α Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Eyjafjalla, Saria, Bagpipe)
Type-β Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Surtr, Mudrock, Saga)
Type-γ Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Pozëmka, Executor the Ex Foedere, Dorothy)

Players will receive the chosen custom headhunting permit upon purchase. The selected permit can be used to perform a [Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting] that guarantees one random 6-star Operator from its pool.
[Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting]:
- You may select only one of the Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting Permits and purchase only once. This choice is final and cannot be changed after purchase.

- The permit is good for [Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting]. For this headhunting, the number of rolls without a 6-star Operator will not be accumulated or applied to any [Standard Headhunting], and will remain separate from any accumulated rolls on other [Standard Headhuntings].

- For this Headhunting, players are guaranteed to receive a 6-star Operator when performing a 10-roll. The available pool of 6-star Operators is the same for every player, and depends on the [Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting] pool chosen.
NOTE:
- Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting Permit expires at: September 16, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- You may only use this Headhunting Permit once. Upon use, its Headhunting pool will automatically be removed.
- If not used by the expiration date, this Headhunting Permit will be removed from your Depot, so please make sure to use it before it expires.
Aside from a guaranteed 6-star Operator from the selected Headhunting Permit, the pull rates for the [Half Year Anniv. Special Ten-roll Headhunting] are as follows:
★6 Operator: 2%
★5 Operator: 8%
★4 Operator: 50%
★3 Operator: 40%
12 SEASONS FOURFOLD, NEW FURNITURE SET – SHENNONG TEMPLE FAIR & DAHUANG TIANSHI INSTITUTE
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed Furniture, Shennong Temple Fair, and Dahuang Tianshi Institute will be available during the event.
Shennong Temple Fair
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Limited-time sale at the Store
Dahuang Tianshi Institute
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Here A People Sows event rewards and redeemable (pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (pieces)
13 SEASONS FOURFOLD, R ECRUITMENT OPERATORS UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: July 31, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: After the update, the following Operators will be permanently added to Recruitment.
★★★★★★: Surtr
★★★★★: April
★★★★: Arene
NOTE:
During this update, tags that have not yet been used for recruitment will be refreshed. Please stay tuned for further information.
14 SHARE FEATURE AVAILABLE
UPDATE TIME: July 31, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Players can share certain in-game screens such as their Profile, via screenshots that can be saved or posted on social media. Please stay tuned for more details.
15 SEASONS FOURFOLD, SPECIAL LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: During the event period, players can receive gift emails from different Operators at various time intervals.
ELIGIBILITY: Players who registered and named the Doctor before July 31, 2024, 11:00 (UTC-7).
NOTES:
- The details of the gifts and the email delivery will be determined based on the actual event.
- The event emails will be valid for 7 days. Please remember to claim them in time.
16 SEASONS FOURFOLD, 2024 FESTIVAL SIGN-IN

DETAILS: During the event period, players can log in on July 31, August 3, August 6, and August 9 to receive specific Operator blessings along with a certain amount of Orundum. The received blessings can be added to players' own collection of Blessings. Additionally, the Operator blessings can be shared or saved as wallpapers. Players can log in for a total of 10 days to receive event-exclusive Furniture, Module Materials, Emergency Sanity Concentrate, among other rewards.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2: Tactical Battle Record * 20, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Chip Catalyst * 1, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
Day 4: Strategic Battle Record * 10, Sugar Pack * 3
Day 5: LMD * 30000, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 6: Skill Summary - 3 * 8, Crystalline Component * 3
Day 7: Data Supplement Instrument * 3, Pure Gold * 20
Day 8: Exclusive Furniture - 'Yanese Festive Hanging Ornament' * 1, Furniture Part * 300
Day 9: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Orirock Cluster * 3
Day 10: Module Data Block * 1, Skill Summary - 1 * 30
NOTE:
- Each Operator blessing can be obtained only once.
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
17 PROFILE THEME UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: July 31, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Players reaching Level 80 can unlock the 'Determination' Profile theme. This theme can be viewed and used in Profile. Please stay tuned for more details.
OTHERS:
Stationary Security Service new area open and content update
